title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode9 Cheer Up

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone went home looking so sad.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but I think we were able to give them what they needed to begin finding their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I suppose you're right. Minori, especially!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The cute costumes, the atmosphere, the shining lights... I hope I can put on a show like this someday.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I could see the sparkle in her eyes as she watched our show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! That made me happy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
They're perfectly in sync.
They must really believe in each other to do that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is exactly the kind of show I always wanted to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I won't ever see that view again, though...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think it might take a little more time for those three to find their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's true.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even if it does take time, I still want them to remember how being an idol made them feel.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I agree! Let's do our best to help them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. The best thing we can do for them is to get up on stage and show them what being an idol is all about.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin, let's get back to practicing so we'll be able to cheer Minori and the others up whenever they need it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right! We'll be ready!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, what do you think about coming up with a new performance that'll help cheer them up even more?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think that's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But what kind of performance would be best for that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not sure. Oh, what about using wires?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wires? Like the time we used them to fly out over the crowd?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah! We were flying all over the place!
The crowd loved it! Let's try that again!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great idea! If we're going to do that, then I'd like to come up with a performance that only we could do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A performance only we could do?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In that case, it would have to be one of our perfectly synchronized dances then, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A synchronized dance, hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I know! Instead of just flying around, how about we choreograph a mid-air dance?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A mid-air dance?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. We match our flying to the music and choreograph a dance that's only possible while in the air.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds super fun!
I'm sure everyone is going to love it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Flying around to the rhythm of an upbeat song!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Changing how we sing to match the dance moves!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm getting excited just thinking about it♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me, too! I want to start practicing right away!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All right, let's start setting everything up, then.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Let's give it our best!
We'll be able to cheer up Minori and the others for sure!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!
